statement.excerpt: Even “draw a white bicycle with green wheels”, which focuses purely on part-whole relationships without function or complex syntax, is problematic:
statement.document_title: Form, function, and the giant gulf between drawing a picture and understanding the world

from_speaker: draw a white bicycle with green wheels
our_interpretation: The ordinary reading is that contemporary Stable Diffusion has recurring difficulty assigning requested colors separately to an object and its parts.
For the named example, successful output should depict a white bicycle body or frame with recognizably green wheels.
The claim does not require universal failure, and a single successful image would not refute it.
The post describes ongoing September 2022 behavior without a reporting period. I use September through the publication date as the observation window.
Difficulty assigning colors to separate objects is relevant background but does not by itself establish difficulty assigning colors to an object and its parts.
criteria.support_condition: Independent contemporary outputs show repeated failures on the named bicycle prompt or closely comparable simple object-and-part color prompts during the target period.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Representative independent contemporary testing shows reliable assignment of the requested colors to the bicycle and its wheels, together with comparable simple object-and-part prompts.
